lede: The biggest item this week is the San Miguel County BOCC special meeting Wednesday, where the Housing Authority will consider Resolution 2026-34, a change to Area Median Income limits for deed-restricted properties at Pinion Park — the kind of technical adjustment that quietly determines who qualifies for affordable housing here. Also Wednesday, the County Planning Commission takes up three Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal energy. Over in Ridgway, the Town Council meets Tuesday with fire-related business tied to the Gold Mountain Fire, which has scorched nearly 40,000 acres and repeatedly cut off Highway 550.

notable.stake: Council ratifies disaster declaration support tied to 40,000-acre Gold Mountain Fire.
